population.span: we assigned adults who had been admitted to the intensive care unit (ICU) for severe community-acquired pneumonia

endpoint.span: The primary outcome was death at 28 days.

estimate.span: 25 of 400 patients (6.2%; 95% confidence interval [CI], 3.9 to 8.6) in the hydrocortisone group and in 47 of 395 patients (11.9%; 95% CI, 8.7 to 15.1) in the placebo group (absolute difference, -5.6 percentage points; 95% CI, -9.6 to -1.7; P = 0.006).

ci.span: absolute difference, -5.6 percentage points; 95% CI, -9.6 to -1.7

treatment_strategy.span: to receive intravenous hydrocortisone (200 mg daily for either 4 or 7 days as determined by clinical improvement, followed by tapering for a total of 8 or 14 days) or to receive placebo. All the patients received standard therapy, including antibiotics and supportive care.

follow_up.span: The primary outcome was death at 28 days.

absent_reason: analysis_set: No source identifies the reported analysis as ITT, mITT, per-protocol, or another defined analysis population. The abstract states that 800 patients underwent randomization and data from 795 were analyzed.
served_mismatch: The served arm counts agree with the source, but apply to day 28, not the specified 30-day or in-hospital timepoint. The served intention-to-treat label is unsupported. The reported between-arm estimate and CI are an absolute difference in percentage points, not an RR and RR CI.

candidate_rejections.span: By day 28, death had occurred in 25 of 400 patients
candidate_rejections.why: Reject attribution of these counts to 30-day or in-hospital mortality; retain them as day-28 mortality.
This does not establish the served intention-to-treat analysis label.

entry_population_matches_question.why: Adults admitted to an ICU for severe community-acquired pneumonia fall within adults hospitalised with community-acquired pneumonia; ITT status remains unstated.
entry_population_matches_question.span: we assigned adults who had been admitted to the intensive care unit (ICU) for severe community-acquired pneumonia

notes: All bound spans use the held abstract. RD and its CI are in percentage points. No RR or RR CI was calculated. The registry explicitly names the endpoint as all-causes mortality at day 28.
